result.instructions: Tools for NeetoCal, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my NeetoCal bookings are still unconfirmed for this week?"; "Show the free slots on my 30-minute discovery call for next Tuesday in Europe/Prague."; "List payments from last month and show which ones were refunded.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NeetoCal data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run neetocal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run neetocal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run neetocal_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. neetocal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: neetocal_list_scheduling_links
tools.title: List scheduling links
tools.description: List the workspace's scheduling links (meeting types with their booking pages): name, type, host and status. Start here to find a meeting_sid. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings.

host_email.description: Only links that this host email can book.

search.description: Search text for the link name.

tools.name: neetocal_get_scheduling_link
tools.title: Get a scheduling link
tools.description: Get one scheduling link by meeting_sid: its settings, hosts, booking rules and status. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings/{meeting_sid}.

meeting_sid.description: The SID from the matching list tool.

tools.name: neetocal_list_meeting_durations
tools.title: List meeting durations
tools.description: List the duration options of a scheduling link. Use a duration value when you ask for slots. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings/{meeting_sid}/durations.

meeting_sid.description: The SID from the matching list tool.

tools.name: neetocal_list_available_slots
tools.title: List available slots
tools.description: List the open booking slots of a scheduling link for one month, in the given time zone. Pass day to narrow to one date. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings/{meeting_sid}/slots.

meeting_sid.description: The SID from the matching list tool.

duration.description: Duration in minutes (from the durations list).

host_email.description: Only slots for this host email.

override_availability.description: Include slots that date overrides would block.

add_on_service_ids.description: Add-on service ids that lengthen the booking.

tools.name: neetocal_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings in the workspace. Filter by client email, host email, booking type or parent booking. Results are paged. NeetoCal API: GET /bookings.

client_email.description: Only bookings for this client email.

host_email.description: Only bookings for this host email.

type.description: Booking type filter, as the list returns it.

parent_booking_id.description: Only bookings created with this parent booking.

tools.name: neetocal_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by booking_sid: client, host, slot time, status, payment and meeting outcome. NeetoCal API: GET /bookings/{booking_sid}.

booking_sid.description: The SID from the matching list tool.

tools.name: neetocal_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments for bookings and package purchases, newest first, optionally in a time range. Use it for payment reports. NeetoCal API: GET /payments.

from_time.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 date-time.

to_time.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 date-time.

status.description: Payment status. Omit to get successful payments.

meeting_sid.description: Only payments for this scheduling link.

tools.name: neetocal_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the team members (hosts) of the workspace. Filter by email. NeetoCal API: GET /team-members.

email.description: Only the member with this email.

tools.name: neetocal_list_availabilities
tools.title: List availabilities
tools.description: List the weekly availabilities and date overrides of one or more team members, by email. NeetoCal API: GET /availabilities.

emails.description: Team member emails to read availability for.

tools.name: neetocal_list_holidays
tools.title: List holidays
tools.description: List the workspace holidays. On a holiday no host can be booked for the whole day, unless the availability has a date override. NeetoCal API: GET /holidays.

search.description: Search text for the holiday name.

tools.name: neetocal_update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: Change one booking by booking_sid. Set status to cancelled, approved or rejected; or reschedule it with slot_date and slot_start_time. Cancelling or rejecting changes what the client sees. NeetoCal API: PATCH /bookings/{booking_sid}.

booking_sid.description: The SID from the matching list tool.

slot_date.description: New date to reschedule to, yyyy-mm-dd.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the new slot, e.g. Europe/Prague.

override_availability.description: Allow a slot that an availability override would block.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with NeetoCal
prompts.description: What you can do with NeetoCal here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_upcoming_bookings
prompts.title: Review upcoming bookings
prompts.description: List bookings, filtered by client email or host email. Open one booking to read its time, host, status and payment.

prompts.name: check_open_slots_for_a_meeting_type
prompts.title: Check open slots for a meeting type
prompts.description: Find the scheduling link, read its durations, then list the open slots for one month in a time zone.

prompts.name: read_payments_for_a_period
prompts.title: Read payments for a period
prompts.description: List payments for bookings and packages, newest first, within a time range. Use the list for payment reports.

prompts.name: check_team_members_and_holidays
prompts.title: Check team members and holidays
prompts.description: List the team members, their weekly availabilities and the holidays of the workspace.

prompts.name: reschedule_or_cancel_a_booking
prompts.title: Reschedule or cancel a booking
prompts.description: Move a booking to a new date and start time. Or set its status to cancelled, approved or rejected. The client sees the change.
